clips.caption:
Congress is supposed to watch the CIA. That's the point of an oversight hearing - senators ask, the agency answers, the public gets to know.

Kevin's take: it's a script. He acts out both parts - the senator asking about secret operations, the director saying "no, nothing to see here," then thanking them for coming. That exact script ran for thirty straight years on one question: what's really at Area 51.

Two sitting presidents eventually admitted a version of the same thing on record: something was there the whole time, and the CIA didn't let them see it either.
